state_profile.voting_summary: Massachusetts towns report combined totals: no-excuse mail and two weeks of early voting are both heavy, but the published results don't break out methods. Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern; cities and towns report through the evening, with mail postmarked by election day accepted for three days, so totals firm up over the following week. Boston and other large cities typically land late in the evening, shifting the running total bluer as they do.
